mapper.select: SELECT /* WebSocketMapper.searchNotification */ NOTI_ID , RECEIVER_ID , SENDER_ID , NOTI_TYPE , MESSAGE , IS_READ , CREATE_AT , TARGET_URL FROM NOTIFICATION WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{receiverId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTIFICATION SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE RECEIVER_ID = #{receiverId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM /* NotificationMapper.deleteOldNotification (30지난 알림 삭제) */ NOTIFICATION WHERE CREATE_AT < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
